description: List featury requests (tracked bug reports + feature asks) for a project, newest first. Returns a page: { requests, offset, limit, hasMore }. Each entry is a COMPACT row (id, refCode, kind, status, severity, horizon, realitySize, realityImpact, title, commentCount, mergedIntoTicketId, area, createdAt, updatedAt, shippedAt) sized for board grooming: updatedAt is when the request last moved, shippedAt when it reached production (null until then), area its product area (its own, else the area of the feature it sits on; null when neither has one). Pass detail: "full" for the complete objects, or call get_request for one request's full detail. Without a status filter, only LIVE lanes come back (CLOSED/DECLINED history is excluded, so pass status explicitly to reach it). size and impact filter on the AI reality read (any-of bands): size: ["XS","S"] with impact: ["HIGH","VERY_HIGH"] is the "quick wins" query. Page with offset while hasMore is true. Pass featureId to include requests for that feature and features merged into it. Each entry's id feeds the other request tools. The refCode (e.g. "idea/dark-mode") is the human ref: citing "Closes idea/dark-mode" (or Fixes/Resolves) in a commit/PR message auto-ships that ticket.

detail.description: Payload shape per request. Default "compact" (grooming-sized row); "full" returns the complete ticket objects (heavy: the default limit drops to 20)

featureId.description: Only requests for this feature, including features merged into it

horizon.description: Filter by horizon (NOW = buildable now, NEXT = a strategic bet, VISION = long-range)

impact.description: Filter by reality-read product impact. Any of MINIMAL, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, VERY_HIGH (how much it moves the product once shipped, independent of size). ["HIGH","VERY_HIGH"] alone is the "what matters most" query; requests not yet assessed never match

kind.description: Filter by kind (BUG, CHANGE, or FEATURE_REQUEST)

limit.description: Page size. Default 50 (20 with detail: full), max 500

offset.description: Rows to skip. Default 0; page while hasMore is true

size.description: Filter by reality-read effort size. Any of XS, S, M, L, XL (XS ≈ a day, XL ≈ a quarter-plus). A band like ["XS","S"] finds the quick wins; requests not yet assessed never match

status.description: Filter by lifecycle status (any of OPEN, PLANNED, SPEC, BUILDING, SHIPPED, VERIFYING, CLOSED, DECLINED). Default: the live lanes. Everything except CLOSED/DECLINED

name: list_requests
title: List requests
